defects: Only covers the smooth (C^∞) case (`Smooth`) instead of general C^n for arbitrary n : ℕ∞ω as in the gold statement

Immersion direction is reversed: gold takes φ : N → N' mapping OUT of the codomain N into a further manifold N', with conclusion about φ ∘ f; produced takes e : M' → M mapping INTO the domain M, with conclusion about f ∘ e — this is a structurally different (non-equivalent) claim, not just a renaming

Produced universally quantifies the (would-be) immersion inside the iff rather than fixing it as an external lemma parameter as gold does; since the identity map on M trivially qualifies as such an 'immersion e', the right-hand side collapses to essentially 'continuous ∧ f smooth', making the produced statement trivial/vacuous rather than expressing the genuine (nontrivial) content of the gold theorem

Does not use Mathlib's `IsImmersion` predicate (gold: `IsImmersion J J' n φ`); instead manually encodes an immersion-like condition (smoothness + trivial kernel of mfderiv) only for the reversed map e, which does not correspond to the same mathematical object

Loses the general manifold-with-corners structure of gold (distinct model spaces H, H', G, G' and ModelWithCorners I, I', J, J'); produced conflates models directly with 𝓘(𝕜,E)/𝓘(𝕜,E') and forces the auxiliary manifold M' to share the same model E as M, rather than allowing an independent further manifold/model as gold's N', J' do
